description: PreToolUse on Edit, Write and Bash is xtask permit over the hook's stdin (harness-design.md §4.4). The built binary is a process start; cargo run is the fallback when none is built and costs about 200 ms more.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && exec "$x" permit; done; exec cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit
